items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: Butch Miles. He’s the epitome of a good swing drummer.

ctx.x: Do you have an idea on how to define that? © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

Yeah. It has a beat. There’s no other beat like it. And there are people who played in the swing era who weren’t swingers, but the minute I hear it I know it. The beat. It’s a heavy four/four beat, and — it’s heavy but it’s light at the same time. It’s totally unlike the rock & roll stuff with the drummer banging away. I mean that doesn’t take any talent to do that. But you see if a fellow like Butch, Butch Miles. He’s the epitome of a good swing drummer. Now all you have to do is listen to him make rhythm and…
